parking: Kawagoe Route trailhead parking
notes: One of Japan's 100 Famous Mountains. The 1888 eruption produced lahars that killed 461 people and created over 300 ponds. Main summit trail (Kawagoe Route) takes 3–4 hours one way. Often paired with Goshikinuma ponds visit.

name: Ouchi-juku
description: A remarkably preserved Edo-period post town in Fukushima's mountains where thatched-roof farmhouses line a single main street of the ancient Aizu Nishi-Kaido highway. A living museum of feudal-era Japan with the famous leek soba tradition.
reservation: None required (restaurants may have queues)
parking: Large car park at entrance (¥500)
notes: Designated Important Preservation District. The "negi soba" tradition of eating buckwheat noodles using a whole green onion as chopstick originated here. Especially atmospheric during winter snow (late Jan–Feb). About 15 min drive from Tsuruga Castle.

name: Tsuruga Castle

name: Yamadera (Risshakuji Temple)
description: A mountain temple complex founded in 860 AD, climbing 1,015 stone steps up a moss-covered cliff face. Immortalised by haiku master Matsuo Basho's verse "the silence — penetrating the rocks, a cicada's cry", it remains Tohoku's most iconic spiritual landscape.
reservation: None required
parking: Village parking near station
notes: Admission ¥300 to climb beyond Sanmon gate. Counts 1,015 steps. Wear comfortable shoes. The Godaido viewing platform overhangs the cliff for dramatic valley photos. Easy train from Yamagata city (17 min).

ja.description: 1053年に極楽浄土をイメージして建立されたユネスコ世界遺産寺院です。10円硬貨に描かれた鳳凰堂と阿字池に映る水鏡の美しさが世界中の観光客を魅了します。

name: Uji Tea Culture Center & Ujigami Shrine
nameJa: 宇治茶文化館・宇治上神社
description: Japan's oldest original shrine main hall nestled in historic Uji, surrounded by traditional matcha tea houses. Visitors can try authentic matcha grinding and ceremonial green tea tasting.
notes: Famous for high-grade Uji Matcha tea tastings.
notesJa: 【見どころ】日本最古の神社本殿を持つ世界遺産・宇治上神社と宇治茶体験が魅力です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】参拝・茶屋利用は事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】近隣有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Japan's oldest original shrine main hall with traditional matcha tea houses.

en.name: Uji Tea Culture Center & Ujigami Shrine
en.description: Japan's oldest original shrine main hall nestled in historic Uji, surrounded by traditional matcha tea houses. Visitors can try authentic matcha grinding and ceremonial green tea tasting.

ja.name: 宇治茶文化館・宇治上神社
ja.description: 日本最古の神社本殿を擁する宇治上神社と、老舗宇治茶舗が並ぶ門前エリアです。挽きたての抹茶体験や伝統的なお茶会を風情溢れる宇治川のせせらぎと共に楽しめます。
highlights: 本格抹茶石臼挽き体験

name: Mimuroto-ji Hydrangea Temple
description: Renowned as Kansai's 'Hydrangea Temple', boasting 20,000 colorful hydrangea bushes and lotus ponds set against wooded hills. In June, special evening illuminations showcase spectacular floral views.
notes: Peak hydrangea season is June to July.
notesJa: 【見どころ】初夏に約20,000株のアジサイが咲き誇る「あじさい寺」として有名です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid seasonal parking
parkingJa: 【駐車場】あじさい園開園期は有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Renowned as Kansai's Hydrangea Temple with 20,000 blooming flowers.

en.name: Mimuroto-ji Hydrangea Temple
en.description: Renowned as Kansai's 'Hydrangea Temple', boasting 20,000 colorful hydrangea bushes and lotus ponds set against wooded hills. In June, special evening illuminations showcase spectacular floral views.

ja.name: 三室戸寺
ja.description: 5,000坪の庭園に約50種20,000株のあじさいが咲き乱れる関西有数の「あじさい寺」です。ハート型のあじさい探しや、ハス池・ツツジ園など四季折々の花を楽しめます。

name: Ine Funaya Boathouses
description: A unique coastal village featuring 230 traditional wooden boathouses built directly over Ine Bay's water level. Often called 'the Venice of Japan', visitors can take sea taxi boat tours.
notes: Sea taxi boat tours operate daily from Ine port.
notesJa: 【見どころ】海に直接浮かんでいるように見える230軒の伝統的舟屋群です。
reservation: Sea taxi tours available on site
reservationJa: 【予約】海上タクシー遊覧は現地随時受け付けです。
parking: Paid public parking in Ine Town
parkingJa: 【駐車場】伊根町内に有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Unique coastal village with 230 traditional wooden boathouses over Ine Bay.

en.name: Ine Funaya Boathouses
en.description: A unique coastal village featuring 230 traditional wooden boathouses built directly over Ine Bay's water level. Often called 'the Venice of Japan', visitors can take sea taxi boat tours.

ja.name: 伊根の舟屋
ja.description: 伊根湾の波静かな海辺に約230軒の舟屋が連続して建ち並ぶ、日本で最も海に近いノスタルジックな集落です。海上タクシーでの周遊や、舟屋見学・地酒蔵元巡りが人気です。

name: Kasamatsu Park Lookout
description: The birthplace of 'Matanoki' (upside-down viewing), offering famous panoramic views of Amanohashidate sandbar spanning Miyazu Bay. Accessible via funicular railway and chairlift.
notes: Funicular and chairlift ride included in ticket.
notesJa: 【見どころ】股のぞきで天橋立が天に架かる龍のように見える絶景展望台です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking at cable car station
parkingJa: 【駐車場】ケーブルカー乗り場近くに有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Birthplace of upside-down viewing with panoramic views of Amanohashidate.

en.name: Kasamatsu Park Lookout
en.description: The birthplace of 'Matanoki' (upside-down viewing), offering famous panoramic views of Amanohashidate sandbar spanning Miyazu Bay. Accessible via funicular railway and chairlift.

ja.name: 傘松公園
ja.description: 天橋立を北側から一望できる絶景台で、「股のぞき」発祥の地として知られます。股のぞき台から見ると、天橋立が昇り龍（昇龍観）のように天へ駆け上がる姿を鑑賞できます。
highlights: ケーブルカー・リフト

name: Koko-en Garden
description: Nine distinct Edo-style Japanese gardens constructed on the historic site of Lord Himeji's samurai residences. Features waterfalls, koi ponds, and a green tea ceremony pavilion.
notes: Discounted combined tickets available with Himeji Castle.
notesJa: 【見どころ】姫路城を借景とする9つの江戸風情あふれる日本庭園です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です（姫路城共通券がお得です）。
parking: Paid public parking nearby
parkingJa: 【駐車場】姫路城周辺有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Nine distinct Edo-style Japanese gardens built on samurai residence sites.

en.name: Koko-en Garden
en.description: Nine distinct Edo-style Japanese gardens constructed on the historic site of Lord Himeji's samurai residences. Features waterfalls, koi ponds, and a green tea ceremony pavilion.

ja.name: 好古園
ja.description: 姫路城西御屋敷跡の発掘調査成果を活かして造営された3.5ヘクタールの本格的日本庭園群です。瀧の庭や茶の庭、夏木の庭など、江戸の風情漂う9つの異なる庭園を散策できます。

name: Engyo-ji Temple Mount Shosha
description: A monumental 1,000-year-old Tendai Buddhist temple complex atop Mt. Shosha, famous as a filming location for 'The Last Samurai'. Reached via Mt. Shosha Ropeway.
notes: Mt. Shosha Ropeway operates every 15 minutes.
notesJa: 【見どころ】映画「ラストサムライ」ロケ地となった格式高い千年の古刹です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking at ropeway station
parkingJa: 【駐車場】ロープウェイ山麓駅に有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: 1,000-year-old Tendai temple complex atop Mt. Shosha filmed in The Last Samurai.

en.name: Engyo-ji Temple Mount Shosha
en.description: A monumental 1,000-year-old Tendai Buddhist temple complex atop Mt. Shosha, famous as a filming location for 'The Last Samurai'. Reached via Mt. Shosha Ropeway.

ja.name: 書寫山圓教寺
ja.description: 966年に性空上人によって開山された西国三十三所第27番札所の大古刹です。崖造りの摩尼殿や重厚な三ツ堂が豊かな自然林の中に佇み、「西の比叡山」と称されます。

name: Izushi Historic Castle Town
description: Known as 'Little Kyoto of Tajima', featuring preserved samurai residences, Japan's oldest clock tower Shinkorou, and famous Izushi Sara Soba served on small porcelain plates.
notes: Try the Sara Soba Meguri passport for 3 restaurants.
notesJa: 【見どころ】小京都の風情漂う城下町と、名物「出石皿そば」の食べ歩きが人気です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid public parking in Izushi
parkingJa: 【駐車場】出石町内に有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Preserved samurai castle town famous for Shinkorou clock tower and Sara Soba.

en.name: Izushi Historic Castle Town
en.description: Known as 'Little Kyoto of Tajima', featuring preserved samurai residences, Japan's oldest clock tower Shinkorou, and famous Izushi Sara Soba served on small porcelain plates.

ja.name: 出石城下町
ja.description: 但馬の小京都と称される風情ある城下町で、明治創業の辰鼓楼（時計台）や出石城跡、家老屋敷が残ります。小皿に盛られた出石皿そばを何皿も味わうグルメ散策が名物です。
highlights: 日本最古の時計台「辰鼓楼」

name: Genbudo Basalt Cave Park
description: A San'in Kaigan UNESCO Global Geopark site showcasing dramatic 1.6-million-year-old hexagonal basalt column formations created by cooling volcanic lava.
notes: Genbudo Museum features giant mineral crystals and fossils.
notesJa: 【見どころ】160万年前の火山活動が造り出した六角形の玄武岩柱状節理の奇岩です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Free parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: UNESCO Geopark site with 1.6-million-year-old hexagonal basalt column caves.

en.name: Genbudo Basalt Cave Park
en.description: A San'in Kaigan UNESCO Global Geopark site showcasing dramatic 1.6-million-year-old hexagonal basalt column formations created by cooling volcanic lava.

ja.name: 玄武洞公園
ja.description: 山陰海岸ユネスコ世界ジオパークに指定された天然記念物で、マグマが冷却してできた規則正しい柱状節理が壁画のように広がります。四神の名を冠した玄武・青龍・白虎・朱雀洞が見所です。

name: Ritsuunkyo Sea of Clouds Viewpoint
description: The premier vantage point situated directly across the valley from Takeda Castle, offering breathtaking early-morning views of the 'Castle in the Sky' floating above a sea of clouds.
notes: Best sea of clouds occurs autumn mornings between 06:00 and 08:00.
notesJa: 【見どころ】雲海に浮かぶ竹田城跡を正面から望む「天空の城」絶景展望台です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking at trailhead
parkingJa: 【駐車場】登山口に有料駐車場あり。
openingHoursJa: 24時間開放（早朝登山がおすすめ）

editorial.editorialSummary: Premier vantage point facing Takeda Castle above early-morning clouds.

en.name: Ritsuunkyo Sea of Clouds Viewpoint
en.description: The premier vantage point situated directly across the valley from Takeda Castle, offering breathtaking early-morning views of the 'Castle in the Sky' floating above a sea of clouds.
highlights: Takeda Castle Sea of Clouds View

ja.name: 立雲峡
ja.description: 朝来山の中腹に位置し、竹田城跡を円山川を挟んで真向かいに望む展望スポットです。秋から冬の早朝、雲海に包まれて浮かび上がる竹田城の神秘的な姿を撮影できます。
highlights: 展望台ハイキングコース

name: Ikuno Historic Silver Mine
description: A major historic silver mine operating from 807 AD through the modern era, featuring 1km of cool underground mining tunnels with life-sized animatronic miner displays.
notes: Underground tunnel temperature stays at 13°C year-round.
notesJa: 【見どころ】室町時代から昭和まで採掘された大銀山で、年間通して13℃の坑道見学が楽しめます。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Free parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Historic silver mine with 1km cool underground tunnels and mining exhibits.

en.name: Ikuno Historic Silver Mine
en.description: A major historic silver mine operating from 807 AD through the modern era, featuring 1km of cool underground mining tunnels with life-sized animatronic miner displays.

ja.name: 生野銀山
ja.description: 織田信長や豊臣秀吉、徳川家康も直轄地とした日本を代表する大銀山です。総延長350kmに及ぶ坑道のうち1kmが公開され、当時の採掘作業をリアルに再現した展示が見所です。
highlights: スーパーアイドル「GINZAN BOYZ」

name: Hokki-ji Three-Story Pagoda
description: UNESCO World Heritage site housing Japan's oldest surviving three-story wooden pagoda, completed in 706 AD. Set amidst idyllic countryside cosmos flower fields.
notes: Beautiful autumn cosmos fields surround the pagoda in October.
notesJa: 【見どころ】706年完成の日本最古の三重塔を擁する世界遺産寺院です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Free parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: UNESCO World Heritage site housing Japan's oldest surviving wooden 3-story pagoda.

en.name: Hokki-ji Three-Story Pagoda
en.description: UNESCO World Heritage site housing Japan's oldest surviving three-story wooden pagoda, completed in 706 AD. Set amidst idyllic countryside cosmos flower fields.

ja.name: 法起寺
ja.description: 聖徳太子の遺言により建立された法隆寺の支院で、現存日本最古の三重塔（国宝）が建ちます。秋には寺を囲むコスモス畑が咲き誇り、斑鳩の長閑な田園風景を彩ります。

name: Chogosonshi-ji Tiger Temple
description: A dramatic mountain temple on Mt. Shigi famous for giant paper-mache tiger statues and evening paper lantern paths. Dedicated to Bishamonten for good fortune and victory.
notes: World's largest paper-mache tiger 'World's Best Tiger' at entrance.
notesJa: 【見どころ】信貴山に立ち世界一大きな「張り子の虎」と灯籠参道が名物の開運寺院です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Dramatic mountain temple on Mt. Shigi famous for giant paper-mache tiger statues.

en.name: Chogosonshi-ji Tiger Temple
en.description: A dramatic mountain temple on Mt. Shigi famous for giant paper-mache tiger statues and evening paper lantern paths. Dedicated to Bishamonten for good fortune and victory.

ja.name: 朝護孫子寺
ja.description: 信貴山に広がる毘沙門天王の総本山で、寅の年・寅の日・寅の刻に毘沙門天が現れた故事から「寅の寺」として信仰を集めます。境内の「大張り子の虎」や本堂舞台からの眺望が見所です。
highlights: 世界一の大張り子の虎

name: Enryaku-ji Mount Hiei Monastery
description: UNESCO World Heritage monastery complex sprawling across Mt. Hiei overlooking Lake Biwa and Kyoto. Founded in 788 by Saicho, it is the mother temple of Japanese Tendai Buddhism.
notes: The Eternal Inextinguishable Buddhist Lantern burns in Konpon Chudo.
notesJa: 【見どころ】比叡山山上に広がる天台宗の総本山で、1200年間燃え続ける「不滅の法灯」が見所です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking on Mt. Hiei Driveway
parkingJa: 【駐車場】比叡山ドライブウェイ内に有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: UNESCO World Heritage monastery atop Mt. Hiei overlooking Lake Biwa.

en.name: Enryaku-ji Mount Hiei Monastery
en.description: UNESCO World Heritage monastery complex sprawling across Mt. Hiei overlooking Lake Biwa and Kyoto. Founded in 788 by Saicho, it is the mother temple of Japanese Tendai Buddhism.

ja.name: 比叡山延暦寺
ja.description: 伝教大師最澄によって開かれた天台宗の総本山で、比叡山全域を境内とする日本仏教の母山です。東塔・西塔・横川の3エリアに国宝・重要文化財の堂宇が点在します。
highlights: 坂本ケーブルからの琵琶湖眺望

name: Ukimido Mangetsu-ji Floating Temple
description: Famous as 'Katata no Miko' from the Eight Views of Omi, featuring a serene wooden Buddhist hall extending over Lake Biwa on stone pillars.
notes: Houses 1,000 Amida Buddha statues inside the lake pavilion.
notesJa: 【見どころ】近江八景「堅田の落雁」で名高い琵琶湖上に浮かぶ美しい御堂です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Free parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Serene wooden Buddhist hall built on stone pillars over the waters of Lake Biwa.

en.name: Ukimido Mangetsu-ji Floating Temple
en.description: Famous as 'Katata no Miko' from the Eight Views of Omi, featuring a serene wooden Buddhist hall extending over Lake Biwa on stone pillars.

ja.name: 浮御堂（満月寺）
ja.description: 平安時代に湖上安全と衆生済度を祈願して建立された臨済宗の古刹です。琵琶湖の湖中に伸びる石橋の先に佇む木造のお堂と、湖面に映る景観が近江八景の絶景として知られます。
highlights: 近江八景・堅田の落雁

name: Genkyuen Feudal Garden
description: A breathtaking Edo-period Japanese stroll garden built in 1677 by Lord Hikone, designed to mirror the Four Seasons with Hikone Castle tower reflected in its central pond.
notes: Located directly adjacent to Hikone Castle moat.
notesJa: 【見どころ】琵琶湖や近江八景を模して造られた彦根藩主・井伊家の美しき大名庭園です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です（彦根城共通券あり）。
parking: Paid parking at Hikone Castle
parkingJa: 【駐車場】彦根城駐車場利用可。

editorial.editorialSummary: Edo-period Japanese stroll garden reflecting Hikone Castle tower in its central pond.

en.name: Genkyuen Feudal Garden
en.description: A breathtaking Edo-period Japanese stroll garden built in 1677 by Lord Hikone, designed to mirror the Four Seasons with Hikone Castle tower reflected in its central pond.

ja.name: 玄宮園
ja.description: 彦根城の北側に広がる4代藩主井伊直興によって造営された池泉回遊式の大名庭園です。鳳翔台での呈茶や、池越しに見上げる国宝・彦根城天守閣の壮大な景観を楽しめます。

name: Miho Museum Koka
description: I.M. Pei's modernist architectural masterpiece hidden in Shiga's wooded mountains, accessed via a dramatic silver tunnel and suspension bridge. Houses ancient Egyptian, Persian, and Asian art.
notes: Closed Mondays and winter off-season (Dec-Mar).
notesJa: 【見どころ】I.M.ペイ設計の山中に埋め込まれた幻想的な建築と古代美術コレクションです。
reservation: Timed advance ticket recommended online
reservationJa: 【予約】開館シーズン中はオンライン事前予約券を推薦します。
parking: Free parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: I.M. Pei's subterranean mountain museum reached through a silver tunnel.

en.name: Miho Museum Koka
en.description: I.M. Pei's modernist architectural masterpiece hidden in Shiga's wooded mountains, accessed via a dramatic silver tunnel and suspension bridge. Houses ancient Egyptian, Persian, and Asian art.

ja.name: MIHO MUSEUM
ja.description: ルーヴルのガラスのピラミッドで知られるI.M.ペイ氏が桃源郷をイメージして設計した山中の美術館です。しだれ桜のトンネルと吊り橋を渡ると、80%が地下に埋設された美しい空間が広がります。
highlights: アプローチトンネルと吊り橋
古代エジプト・ペルシャ美術

name: Okage Yokocho & Oharai-machi
nameJa: おかげ横丁・おはらい町
description: A bustling 800-meter historic merchant street leading directly to Ise Jingu Naiku, lined with preserved Edo-period wooden shopfronts, Akafuku rice cake houses, and Ise udon stalls.
notes: Famous for Akafuku mochi and Ise Udon noodles.
notesJa: 【見どころ】伊勢神宮内宮の門前町で、江戸・明治の木造町家と名物赤福・伊勢うどんを楽しめます。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid public parking in Ise
parkingJa: 【駐車場】市営有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Bustling Edo-style historic street leading to Ise Shrine with Akafuku sweets.

en.name: Okage Yokocho & Oharai-machi
en.description: A bustling 800-meter historic merchant street leading directly to Ise Jingu Naiku, lined with preserved Edo-period wooden shopfronts, Akafuku rice cake houses, and Ise udon stalls.

ja.name: おかげ横丁・おはらい町
ja.description: 伊勢神宮内宮の鳥居前から続く約800mの石畳の参道街です。江戸から明治期の伊勢路の建造物を移築・再現したおかげ横丁では、名物「赤福餅」や極太もちもちの「伊勢うどん」を堪能できます。

name: Kishi Station Tama Cat Conductor
description: The famous countryside train station on the Wakayama Electric Railway, world-renowned for its feline Stationmasters (Tama II Nitama and Yontama) working inside a cat-shaped station building.
notes: Check cat stationmaster duty schedules online before visiting.
notesJa: 【見どころ】猫の顔の形をした駅舎と、三毛猫の「ニタマ駅長」が働く名物駅です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です（いちご電車やたま電車の乗車券が便利です）。
parking: No station parking; take Kishigawa Line train
parkingJa: 【駐車場】駅前駐車場無しため、和歌山駅から貴志川線電車利用を推奨。

editorial.editorialSummary: Famous railway station home to feline Stationmaster Nitama and cat station building.

en.name: Kishi Station Tama Cat Conductor
en.description: The famous countryside train station on the Wakayama Electric Railway, world-renowned for its feline Stationmasters (Tama II Nitama and Yontama) working inside a cat-shaped station building.

ja.name: 貴志駅・たま駅長
ja.description: 和歌山電鐵貴志川線の終着駅で、三毛猫が駅長を務めるユニークな人気スポットです。檜皮葺きの猫型駅舎にはたまカフェやたま神社が併設され、可愛らしい「たま電車」で訪れることができます。
highlights: たま電車・いちご電車

name: Okunoin Sacred Forest Cemetery
description: Japan's most sacred forest cemetery, featuring over 200,000 mossy stone stupas lining a 2km path through ancient cedar trees leading to Kobo Daishi's mausoleum.
notes: Torodo Hall of 10,000 Lanterns glows continuously day and night.
notesJa: 【見どころ】樹齢数百年の杉木立に20万基超の墓石が立ち並ぶ弘法大師御廟の聖地です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です（ナイトツアー有）。
parking: Free parking at Okunoin entrance
parkingJa: 【駐車場】奥之院前に無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Sacred forest cemetery with 200,000 mossy stone stupas surrounding Kobo Daishi mausoleum.

en.name: Okunoin Sacred Forest Cemetery
en.description: Japan's most sacred forest cemetery, featuring over 200,000 mossy stone stupas lining a 2km path through ancient cedar trees leading to Kobo Daishi's mausoleum.

ja.name: 高野山 奥之院
ja.description: 弘法大師空海が入定（永眠）されている真言密教最大の聖地です。一の橋から御廟までの約2kmの参道には、織田信長や豊臣秀吉ら歴史的武将の墓碑や数百年を超す杉木立が神秘的な空気を醸し出します。

name: Senjojiki & Sandanbeki Rock Cliffs
description: Spectacular coastal rock formations in Shirahama featuring a multi-tiered sandstone plateau and 50-meter ocean cliff cave used by historic Kumano Navy pirates.
notes: Elevator access down inside Sandanbeki Cave available.
notesJa: 【見どころ】広大な岩盤の千畳敷と、熊野水軍の隠し洞窟がある50mの断崖絶壁です。
reservation: No reservation needed for cave
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Free parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Spectacular multi-tiered sandstone plateau and 50m ocean cavern pirate cliffs.

en.name: Senjojiki & Sandanbeki Rock Cliffs
en.description: Spectacular coastal rock formations in Shirahama featuring a multi-tiered sandstone plateau and 50-meter ocean cliff cave used by historic Kumano Navy pirates.

ja.name: 千畳敷・三段壁洞窟
ja.description: 太平洋の荒波が削り出した白浜の二大名勝です。畳を千枚敷ける広さの「千畳敷」と、高さ50mの断崖地下鉄エレベーターで降りる「三段壁洞窟（熊野水軍の隠し洞窟）」が圧巻です。
highlights: 千畳敷の岩盤大パノラマ
三段壁洞窟（エレベーター内部探検）

name: Sakai City Museum & Daisen Kofun View
nameJa: 堺市博物館・大仙陵古墳
description: Located within Daisen Park facing Emperor Nintoku's tomb, featuring VR exhibits of ancient keyhole kofun mounds, samurai swords, and Sen no Rikyu tea culture history.
notes: VR Kofun tour available at the museum theater.
notesJa: 【見どころ】仁徳天皇陵古墳（大仙陵古墳）に隣接し、巨大古墳のVR体験や千利休の茶の湯文化を学べます。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking in Daisen Park
parkingJa: 【駐車場】大仙公園駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Museum facing Nintoku Kofun featuring VR ancient mound tours and tea history.

en.name: Sakai City Museum & Daisen Kofun View
en.description: Located within Daisen Park facing Emperor Nintoku's tomb, featuring VR exhibits of ancient keyhole kofun mounds, samurai swords, and Sen no Rikyu tea culture history.

ja.name: 堺市博物館・大仙陵古墳
ja.description: 世界遺産・百舌鳥古墳群の中心に位置する博物館です。仁徳天皇陵古墳のVR空中散歩体験や、堺が生んだ茶の湯の大成者・千利休ゆかりの展示・茶室などを鑑賞できます。

name: Lake Biwa Scenic Cruise & Coast
nameJa: 琵琶湖クルーズ・湖畔
description: Japan's largest freshwater lake offering scenic paddle-wheel steamboat cruises on the Michigan, watersports, and tranquil lakeside walking promenades.
notes: Michigan cruise departs daily from Otsu Port.
notesJa: 【見どころ】日本最大の湖で、外輪船ミシガン号での陽気な湖上クルーズや白砂青松の湖畔散策が楽しめます。
reservation: Cruise ticket available online or on site
reservationJa: 【予約】ミシガンクルーズ券は当日大津港で購入可能。
parking: Paid parking at Otsu Port
parkingJa: 【駐車場】大津港有料駐車場あり。
openingHoursJa: 09:00 - 17:00（ミシガン運行時間に準ずる）

editorial.editorialSummary: Japan's largest freshwater lake with Michigan paddle-wheel steamboat cruises.

en.name: Lake Biwa Scenic Cruise & Coast
en.description: Japan's largest freshwater lake offering scenic paddle-wheel steamboat cruises on the Michigan, watersports, and tranquil lakeside walking promenades.

ja.name: 琵琶湖クルーズ・湖畔
ja.description: 近江八景の舞台であり日本最大の面積を誇る淡水湖です。アメリカ風外輪船「ミシガン」での音楽付きクルーズや、世界最大級のびわこ花噴水の夜間ライトアップを楽しめます。
highlights: 外輪船ミシガンクルーズ

name: Meoto Iwa Wedded Rocks
description: Two sacred sea rocks joined in matrimony by a heavy straw rope (Shimenawa) off Futami Okitama Shrine. Celebrated for sunrises between the rocks and frog talismans.
notes: Best sunrises occur from May to July.
notesJa: 【見どころ】大注連縄で結ばれた二つの聖なる岩で、縁結びと夫婦円満の象徴として親しまれます。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Free parking at Futami Okitama Shrine
parkingJa: 【駐車場】二見興玉神社無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Sacred sea rocks bound by heavy straw rope representing marriage and worship.

en.name: Meoto Iwa Wedded Rocks
en.description: Two sacred sea rocks joined in matrimony by a heavy straw rope (Shimenawa) off Futami Okitama Shrine. Celebrated for sunrises between the rocks and frog talismans.

ja.name: 夫婦岩
ja.description: 二見興玉神社の沖合に並び立つ男岩と女岩で、神聖な大注連縄で硬く結ばれています。5月〜7月には夫婦岩の間から昇る美しい日の出を、冬には満月を観賞できます。
highlights: 二見興玉神社のカエル守り

name: Wakayama Castle
description: A hilltop fortress built in 1585 by Toyotomi Hideyoshi, featuring a restored white main keep, Momijidani Garden, and Ninja guides assisting visitors.
notes: Ninjutsu trained guides provide free assistance around castle grounds.
notesJa: 【見どころ】虎伏山に立つ紀州徳川家の居城で、紅葉渓庭園と忍者の無料案内が名物です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking on castle grounds
parkingJa: 【駐車場】城内有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Hilltop fortress of the Kishu Tokugawa clan with white keep and Momijidani Garden.

en.name: Wakayama Castle
en.description: A hilltop fortress built in 1585 by Toyotomi Hideyoshi, featuring a restored white main keep, Momijidani Garden, and Ninja guides assisting visitors.

ja.name: 和歌山城
ja.description: 豊臣秀吉の命により藤堂高虎が築城し、徳川御三家の一つ紀州徳川家の居城として栄えた城郭です。天守閣からの360度パノラマや、斜めに架かる御橋廊下、おもてなし忍者の案内が人気です。
highlights: 江戸時代の斜め廊下「御桥廊下」

name: Kataonami Beach & Wakanoura Bay
nameJa: 片男波海水浴場・和歌の浦
description: Selected as one of Japan's Top 100 Beaches, boasting a 1.2km crescent of white sand in historic Wakanoura Bay praised by Manyoshu poets.
notes: Spacious beach park with summer swimming facilities.
notesJa: 【見どころ】万葉集に詠まれた景勝地・和歌の浦に伸びる1,200mの白砂青松の美しい海水浴場です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid beach parking
parkingJa: 【駐車場】片男波公園有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Crescent white sand beach in historic Wakanoura Bay praised in Manyoshu poetry.

en.name: Kataonami Beach & Wakanoura Bay
en.description: Selected as one of Japan's Top 100 Beaches, boasting a 1.2km crescent of white sand in historic Wakanoura Bay praised by Manyoshu poets.

ja.name: 片男波海水浴場・和歌の浦
ja.description: 快水浴場百選特選に選ばれた透明度抜群のビーチです。和歌の浦の万葉の歴史を感じる萬葉館や広大な片男波公園が隣接し、ファミリーからカップルまでリゾート気分を満喫できます。
highlights: 快水浴場百選の白砂青松

name: Danjo Garan Sacred Temple Complex
description: The central temple complex of Koyasan founded by Kobo Daishi, dominated by the majestic 48.5m vermilion Konpon Daito Great Pagoda.
notes: Konpon Daito houses large three-dimensional Mandala statues.
notesJa: 【見どころ】弘法大師が開創した高野山の中心道場で、鮮やかな朱塗りの「根本大塔」が目印です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid public parking in Koyasan
parkingJa: 【駐車場】高野山内無料・有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Central temple complex of Koyasan with 48.5m vermilion Konpon Daito Great Pagoda.

en.name: Danjo Garan Sacred Temple Complex
en.description: The central temple complex of Koyasan founded by Kobo Daishi, dominated by the majestic 48.5m vermilion Konpon Daito Great Pagoda.

ja.name: 高野山 壇上伽藍
ja.description: 高野山真言密教の根本道場として奥之院と並ぶ二大聖地です。高さ48.5mの根本大塔内部には立体曼荼羅が表現され、金堂や不動堂（国宝）など歴史的堂宇が集結します。

name: Shirahama White Beach & Coastal Resort
nameJa: 白良浜・白浜温泉リゾート
description: A famous 600m curve of pure white quartz sand imported from Australia, backed by palm trees and natural seaside hot spring baths.
notes: Sister beach to Waikiki Beach, Hawaii.
notesJa: 【見どころ】サラサラの真っ白な砂浜とエメラルドグリーンの海が広がる関西屈指のリゾートビーチです。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid beach parking
parkingJa: 【駐車場】白良浜有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Famous 600m curve of pure white quartz sand and seaside hot spring resort.

en.name: Shirahama White Beach & Coastal Resort
en.description: A famous 600m curve of pure white quartz sand imported from Australia, backed by palm trees and natural seaside hot spring baths.

ja.name: 白良浜・白浜温泉リゾート
ja.description: 90%の珪酸を含む真っ白でサラサラの砂が特徴の関西を代表するリゾートビーチです。夏の花火大会や、近隣の円月島に沈む美しい夕日、歴史ある白浜温泉の外湯巡りが楽しめます。

name: Toshodai-ji Temple
description: UNESCO World Heritage temple founded in 759 AD by Chinese monk Ganjin, featuring the magnificent 8th-century Golden Hall and serene moss gardens.
notes: Houses the dry-lacquer seated statue of Ganjin (National Treasure).
notesJa: 【見どころ】鑑真和上が759年に建立した唐風建築の傑作で、国宝の金堂や静寂に包まれた苔庭が広がる世界遺産です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking available nearby
parkingJa: 【駐車場】近隣有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: UNESCO World Heritage temple founded in 759 AD by Chinese monk Ganjin with moss gardens.

en.name: Toshodai-ji Temple
en.description: UNESCO World Heritage temple founded in 759 AD by Chinese monk Ganjin, featuring the magnificent 8th-century Golden Hall and serene moss gardens.

ja.name: 唐招提寺
ja.description: 鑑真和上が苦難の末に渡日し、律宗の根本道場として建立した世界遺産です。奈良時代の面影を色濃く残す天平建築の最高峰・金堂や千手観音立像が見所です。

name: Yakushi-ji Temple
description: UNESCO World Heritage temple famous for its twin East and West Pagodas and Fenollosa's 'frozen music' East Pagoda dating back to 730 AD.
notes: Houses the masterwork Yakushi Nyorai Trinity bronze statues.
notesJa: 【見どころ】「凍れる音楽」と称賛された国宝・東塔と、色鮮やかな白鳳文化の大伽藍が美しい世界遺産です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: UNESCO World Heritage temple with twin pagodas and 730 AD East Pagoda.

en.name: Yakushi-ji Temple
en.description: UNESCO World Heritage temple famous for its twin East and West Pagodas and Fenollosa's 'frozen music' East Pagoda dating back to 730 AD.

ja.name: 薬師寺
ja.description: 天武天皇が妃（後の持統天皇）の病気平癒を祈願して建立した白鳳文化の代表的寺院です。創建当時の姿を留める唯一の建造物・東塔と、金堂に鎮座する国宝・薬師三尊像が世界を魅了します。

name: Naramachi Historic Lattice District
description: A charming historic neighborhood filled with Edo-period wooden lattice townhouses, traditional craft shops, and red monkey charm decorations.
notes: Naramachi Koshi-no-Ie offers free visits inside a classic lattice townhouse.
notesJa: 【見どころ】江戸時代の切妻造り町家が軒を連ねる風情豊かな街並みで、町家カフェやクラフトショップ散策を楽しめます。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid public parking in Naramachi
parkingJa: 【駐車場】奈良町周辺有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Charming historic neighborhood filled with Edo-period wooden lattice townhouses.

en.name: Naramachi Historic Lattice District
en.description: A charming historic neighborhood filled with Edo-period wooden lattice townhouses, traditional craft shops, and red monkey charm decorations.

ja.name: ならまち（奈良町）
ja.description: 元興寺の旧境内を中心に広がる歴史的街並みです。狭い路地に格子戸の町家が並び、厄除けの「身代わり猿」が軒先に吊るされた風情ある空間で、古民家カフェや地酒・伝統工芸巡りが満喫できます。

name: Shirahige Shrine Floating Torii
nameJa: 白髭神社・湖中大鳥居
description: Omi's oldest shrine featuring a striking vermilion Torii gate standing directly in the waters of Lake Biwa, known as 'the Itsukushima of Omi'.
notes: Sunset views over Lake Biwa from the observation deck are world-famous.
notesJa: 【見どころ】琵琶湖の沖合に浮かぶ朱塗りの大鳥居が「近江の厳島」と称される近江最古の神社です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Free parking available
parkingJa: 【駐車場】無料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Omi's oldest shrine with a striking vermilion Torii gate standing in Lake Biwa.

en.name: Shirahige Shrine Floating Torii
en.description: Omi's oldest shrine featuring a striking vermilion Torii gate standing directly in the waters of Lake Biwa, known as 'the Itsukushima of Omi'.

ja.name: 白髭神社・湖中大鳥居
ja.description: 垂仁天皇25年に創建された延命長寿の神様を祀る古社です。湖の中に立ち並ぶ美しい鳥居と、対岸の沖島を背に広がる琵琶湖の絶景がSNSやフォトグラファーに絶大な人気を誇ります。

name: Omi-Hachiman Merchant Canal
description: A romantic Edo-period merchant canal lined with white-walled storehouses, stone moats, and traditional hand-rowed Suigo boat tours.
notes: Suigo boat tours offer scenic cruises through lakeside reed beds.
notesJa: 【見どころ】白壁の土蔵や石垣が残る八幡堀と、水郷めぐりのどんこ船遊覧が情趣溢れる城下町です。
reservation: Boat tours available on site or online
reservationJa: 【予約】水郷めぐり船は当日受付可能です。
parking: Paid parking in Omihachiman
parkingJa: 【駐車場】八幡堀周辺有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Romantic Edo merchant canal lined with white storehouses and Suigo boat tours.

en.name: Omi-Hachiman Merchant Canal
en.description: A romantic Edo-period merchant canal lined with white-walled storehouses, stone moats, and traditional hand-rowed Suigo boat tours.

ja.name: 近江八幡・八幡堀
ja.description: 豊臣秀次が築いた城下町の堀で、近江商人の発祥地として栄えた水運の要衝です。四季折々の花が咲く八幡堀沿いの散策や、手漕ぎ船でヨシ原をめぐる「水郷めぐり」が旅情をそそります。
highlights: 近江八幡の水郷めぐり

name: Mount Hiei Driveway & Yumemi Observatory
nameJa: 比叡山ドライブウェイ・夢見が丘
description: A scenic toll road winding up Mt. Hiei, featuring Yumemi-ga-oka Observatory with sweeping day and night panoramas over Lake Biwa and Otsu Harbor.
notes: Includes a mountain coaster and BBQ terrace at Yumemi-ga-oka.
notesJa: 【見どころ】琵琶湖と大津市街の180度絶景夜景が広がる、ドライブと展望テラスが人気のドライブコースです。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Free parking at Yumemi-ga-oka
parkingJa: 【駐車場】夢見が丘に無料大駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Scenic toll road winding up Mt. Hiei with sweeping day and night panoramas over Lake Biwa.

en.name: Mount Hiei Driveway & Yumemi Observatory
en.description: A scenic toll road winding up Mt. Hiei, featuring Yumemi-ga-oka Observatory with sweeping day and night panoramas over Lake Biwa and Otsu Harbor.

ja.name: 比叡山ドライブウェイ・夢見が丘
ja.description: 大津市田の谷峠から比叡山頂を結ぶ観光道路です。途中の「夢見が丘展望台」からは琵琶湖大橋から近江大橋まで一望でき、日中の湖の青さと夜の煌めく街明かりの両方を楽しめます。
highlights: 夢見が丘パノラマ展望台

name: Kimii-dera Temple
description: Famous for 231 stone steps leading up Mt. Nagomi, 500 early-blooming cherry trees, and a 12-meter golden wooden Guanyin statue overlooking Wakanoura Bay.
notes: Climb the 'Musubi-zaka' steps for good match-making fortune.
notesJa: 【見どころ】231段の結縁坂と、早咲き桜の名所、全高12mの金色大観音像が鎮座する名刹です。
reservation: No reservation needed
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です。
parking: Paid parking available at temple entrance
parkingJa: 【駐車場】門前に有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Famous for 231 stone steps, 500 early-blooming cherry trees, and 12m golden Guanyin statue.

en.name: Kimii-dera Temple
en.description: Famous for 231 stone steps leading up Mt. Nagomi, 500 early-blooming cherry trees, and a 12-meter golden wooden Guanyin statue overlooking Wakanoura Bay.

ja.name: 紀三井寺
ja.description: 宝亀元（770）年に開基された西国三十三所第二番札所の古刹です。境内に沸く三井水や関西一早く開花する早咲き桜、231段の石段を上りきった本堂からの和歌の浦の眺望が素晴らしいです。
highlights: 日本最大の木造立像・大観音
早咲き桜と和歌の浦の眺望

name: Kuroshio Market Wakayama Marina City
nameJa: 黒潮市場・和歌山マリーナシティ
description: A lively oceanfront seafood market featuring daily live tuna cutting shows, fresh seafood BBQ terraces, and Wakayama specialty souvenir shopping.
notes: Tuna cutting demonstrations occur 3 times daily.
notesJa: 【見どころ】毎日開催される大迫力のマグロ解体ショーと、海沿いテラスでの新鮮海鮮バーベキューが名物です。
reservation: BBQ tables available on site
reservationJa: 【予約】海鮮BBQは当日現地利用可能です。
parking: Paid parking in Marina City
parkingJa: 【駐車場】マリーナシティ有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Lively oceanfront seafood market featuring daily live tuna cutting shows and BBQ terraces.

en.name: Kuroshio Market Wakayama Marina City
en.description: A lively oceanfront seafood market featuring daily live tuna cutting shows, fresh seafood BBQ terraces, and Wakayama specialty souvenir shopping.

ja.name: 黒潮市場・和歌山マリーナシティ
ja.description: 昭和30年代の商店街を再現した活気溢れる鮮魚市場です。職人が目前で一本の巨大マグロを捌く解体ショーや、市場内で買った海鮮を炭火で味わう海沿いテラスBBQが大人気です。
highlights: 浜焼き海鮮バーベキュー
和歌山ラーメン＆紀州梅干し

name: Tomogashima Islands (Laputa Island)
description: An uninhabited island cluster in the Kii Strait featuring red-brick Meiji military fortress ruins overgrown with ivy, famous as the real-world 'Laputa Island'.
notes: Ferry operates from Kada Port; check weather and ferry schedules.
notesJa: 【見どころ】明治時代の赤レンガ砲台跡が赤ツタに覆われ、ジブリ映画「天空の城ラピュタ」の世界観が広がる無人島です。
reservation: Ferry ticket purchased at Kada Port
reservationJa: 【予約】加太港発の友ヶ島汽船で渡航可能（定員制）。
parking: Paid parking at Kada Port
parkingJa: 【駐車場】加太港に有料駐車場あり。
openingHoursJa: 09:00 - 16:30（友ヶ島汽船ダイヤに準ずる）

editorial.editorialSummary: Uninhabited island cluster with ivy-covered Meiji brick fortress ruins famous as Laputa Island.

en.name: Tomogashima Islands (Laputa Island)
en.description: An uninhabited island cluster in the Kii Strait featuring red-brick Meiji military fortress ruins overgrown with ivy, famous as the real-world 'Laputa Island'.

ja.name: 友ヶ島（ラピュタの島）
ja.description: 紀淡海峡に浮かぶ地ノ島・神島・沖ノ島・虎島の4島群の総称です。明治時代に旧日本軍が築いた第3砲台跡などの赤レンガ要塞施設が原生林と一体化し、アニメ映画さながらの神秘的空間が広がります。
highlights: 第3砲台跡の赤レンガ要塞

name: Kokusai-dori & Makishi Public Market
nameJa: 国際通り・第一牧志公設市場

en.name: Kokusai-dori & Makishi Public Market
en.description: Naha's famous 'Miracle Mile' vibrant avenue lined with Okinawan souvenir shops, awamori distilleries, steak houses, and fresh tropical seafood dining upstairs at Makishi Market.
highlights: Buy Okinawan souvenirs, Chatan salt, and purple yam sweets
Select fresh local fish at Makishi Market and have it cooked upstairs
Enjoy live Okinawan sanshin music performance at local izakayas
en.reservationInfo: No reservation needed for street walk; market restaurants may have wait times at noon.
en.parkingInfo: Paid coin parking lots behind main street.

ja.name: 国際通り・第一牧志公設市場
ja.description: 「奇跡の1マイル」と称される那覇最大の繁華街。お土産屋やステーキハウス、鮮魚が並ぶ公設市場の2階食堂で沖縄グルメを満喫。
highlights: 沖縄銘菓ちんすこうや紫芋スイーツ、泡盛のショッピング
第一牧志公設市場で買った鮮魚を2階食堂で調理してもらう「持ち上げ」体験
夜は三線ライブ居酒屋で賑やかな民謡とオリオンビール
ja.reservationInfo: 通り散策は自由。人気食堂はランチ帯に混雑あり。
ja.parkingInfo: 周辺裏通りにコインパーキング多数。

highlights: Naha's main shopping and entertainment street
Local Okinawan cuisine and souvenir shops
notes: Naha's main shopping street — great for Okinawan souvenirs and street food.
reservation: None required
parking: Nearby paid parking available
notesJa: 那覇のメインストリート。沖縄土産やストリートフードが楽しめる国際通り。

name: Naminoue Shrine & Beach
nameJa: 波上宮・波の上ビーチ

en.name: Naminoue Shrine & Beach
en.description: The primary Shinto shrine of Okinawa perched dramatic on a coral cliff overlooking Naha's city beach and emerald ocean waters.
highlights: Visit the red-tiled Ryukyu-style Shinto shrine on the coral cliff
Relax at Naha City's only public swimming beach below the cliff
Collect unique Okinawan bingata-patterned omamori lucky charms
en.reservationInfo: Free open access.
en.parkingInfo: Small dedicated parking lot available; paid public lots nearby.

ja.name: 波上宮・波の上ビーチ
ja.description: サンゴ礁の断崖上に立つ「一の宮」格の神社。赤瓦の社殿と青い海、足元に広がる那覇唯一の市民ビーチが魅力の景勝地。
highlights: 断崖絶壁に鎮座する朱塗りの波上宮参拝と御朱印受領
紅型（びんがた）模様の鮮やかなお守り授与
社殿下の波の上ビーチで海水浴や海風散策
ja.reservationInfo: 参拝自由・無料。
ja.parkingInfo: 境内駐車場および周辺有料駐車場あり。

notes: The only major Shinto shrine in Okinawa, perched on a clifftop overlooking Naminoue Beach.
reservation: None required
parking: Free parking available
notesJa: 波の上ビーチを見下ろす崖の上に立つ、沖縄随一の神社。

name: Fukushuen Garden

en.name: Fukushuen Garden
en.description: A serene traditional Chinese landscape garden constructed in Naha's Kumemura district using granite and wood imported from Fuzhou, China.
highlights: Stroll across stone arch bridges and fish-filled ponds
Admire Chinese wooden pavilions, pagodas, and artificial waterfall
Experience quiet tea house refreshments inside the garden
en.reservationInfo: Tickets purchased at entrance.
en.parkingInfo: Paid parking available at adjacent Matsuyama Park lot.

ja.name: 福州園
ja.description: 那覇市と中国・福州市の友好都市締結10周年を記念して作られた本格的中国庭園。滝や石橋、木造楼閣が美しい静かな癒やしスポット。
highlights: 福州市の建築様式を取り入れた美しい木造楼閣と石橋
築山から流れ落ちる滝と鯉が泳ぐ池の庭園回遊
クメムラ（久米村）の歴史に触れられる伝統空間
ja.reservationInfo: 現地窓口でチケット購入。
ja.parkingInfo: 近隣の松山公園駐車場等を利用。

highlights: Gift from Fuzhou, Naha's sister city
notes: A tranquil Chinese garden near the city centre — a quiet escape from busy Kokusai Dori.
reservation: None required
parking: Nearby paid parking
notesJa: 那覇の中心部近くにある静かな中国式庭園。福州との姉妹都市提携記念。

name: Nago Pineapple Park
nameJa: 名護パイナップルパーク

en.name: Nago Pineapple Park
en.description: A colorful pineapple theme park featuring automatic cart rides through subtropical botanical gardens, pineapple wine tasting, and fresh pineapple desserts.
highlights: Ride pineapple-shaped automated carts through lush tropical gardens
Sample fresh Okinawan pineapple, cakes, and pineapple wine at the winery
Explore the Dinosaur Adventure zone with roaring animatronic dinos
en.reservationInfo: Tickets available at counter or online discounted vouchers.
en.parkingInfo: Large free parking lot for cars and buses.

ja.name: 名護パイナップルパーク
ja.description: パイナップル号（自動乗用カート）で亜熱帯の植物園を巡るテーマパーク。できたてパイナップルスイーツやワイナリーでの試飲が充実。
highlights: パイナップル号に乗って楽しむ亜熱帯植物とパイナップル畑の周遊
日本初のパイナップルワイナリーでの試飲と直営ショップ限定お菓子
実物大恐竜が出現する「アナザーワールド恐竜探検」ゾーン
ja.reservationInfo: 当日窓口またはWEB前売りチケット購入可能。
ja.parkingInfo: 無料大型駐車場完備。

highlights: Free pineapple tasting at the end
notes: A whimsical pineapple-themed park — great for families and pineapple lovers.
reservation: None required
parking: Free parking available
notesJa: 家族連れに人気のパイナップルテーマパーク。試食も楽しめます。

name: Busena Marine Park & Underwater Observatory
nameJa: ブセナ海中公園・海中展望塔

en.name: Busena Marine Park & Underwater Observatory
en.description: Okinawa's premier marine facility on Busena Cape, offering a 360-degree underwater observation tower and whale-shaped glass-bottom boat tours over coral reefs.
highlights: Descend into underwater tower 4 meters below sea level to watch wild tropical fish
Ride glass-bottom boats to observe vibrant coral reef ecosystems
Stroll along Cape Busena's white sandy beach and resort promenade
en.reservationInfo: Tickets purchased at park reception.
en.parkingInfo: Park visitor parking available inside Busena Resort grounds.

ja.name: ブセナ海中公園・海中展望塔
ja.description: 部瀬名岬に立つ海中展望塔。衣服を着たまま水深4mの海中に入り、360度の丸窓から野生の熱帯魚やサンゴ礁を間近に観察可能。
highlights: 服を着たまま海中世界を楽しめる360度パノラマの海中展望塔
クジラ型のグラス底ボートで巡るサンゴ礁とカラフルな魚群観察
部瀬名岬のラグジュアリーなリゾートビーチ景観
ja.reservationInfo: 公園発券窓口にて当日券購入。
ja.parkingInfo: 敷地内（ザ・ブセナテラス隣接）専用駐車場あり。

highlights: Views of the East China Sea
notes: The underwater observation tower offers excellent views of coral and tropical fish without getting wet.
reservation: None required
parking: Paid parking available
notesJa: 海中展望塔からサンゴと熱帯魚を眺められます。グラスボートも。

name: Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium

en.name: Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium
en.description: One of the world's largest aquariums located inside Ocean Expo Park, world-renowned for its colossal 7,500m³ 'Kuroshio Sea' tank holding multiple whale sharks and reef manta rays.
highlights: Gaze at giant whale sharks and manta rays swimming in Kuroshio Main Tank
Watch free outdoor dolphin shows at Okichan Theater ocean stage
Touch sea stars and sea cucumbers at the coral reef touch pool
en.reservationInfo: Tickets available online or convenience stores with discount, and at park entrance.
en.parkingInfo: Free P7 multi-story parking lot closest to aquarium entrance.

ja.name: 沖縄美ら海水族館
ja.description: 海洋博公園内にある世界トップクラスの水族館。巨大水槽「黒潮の海」で複数のジンベエザメやナンヨウマンタが泳ぐ神秘的な景観が世界的に有名。
highlights: 高さ8.2m・幅22.5mのアクリルパネル越しに見るジンベエザメの給餌体験
東シナ海を背景に繰り広げられる「オキちゃん劇場」のイルカショー（観覧無料）
サンゴ礁の浅瀬を再現したタッチプールと深海生物ゾーン
ja.reservationInfo: 現地窓口、WEBチケット、道の駅許田等で前売り券購入可能。
ja.parkingInfo: 水族館に最も近いP7立体駐車場（無料）が便利。

highlights: One of the world's largest aquarium tanks
notes: Home to whale sharks — arrive early to avoid the heaviest crowds at the Kuroshio tank.
reservation: Online tickets recommended during peak season
parking: Free parking available
notesJa: ジンベエザメが見られる世界有数の大水槽。混雑を避けるなら午前中の到着がおすすめ。

name: Bise Fukugi Tree-Lined Village

en.name: Bise Fukugi Tree-Lined Village
en.description: A quiet coastal village surrounded by thousands of ancient Garcinia (Fukugi) windbreak trees forming green vaulted tunnels that filter sunlight down to sandy footpaths.
highlights: Walk or rent a bicycle along 1km of shaded emerald tree tunnels
Ride a traditional water-buffalo cart guided by local villagers
Reach Bise-zaki point at the end of the path for coral snorkeling
en.reservationInfo: Walking path free; water buffalo cart rides booked on site.
en.parkingInfo: Paid parking lot at Bise-zaki entrance (¥500/day).

ja.name: 備瀬のフクギ並木
ja.description: 台風から家々を守るため植えられた数千本のフクギが並ぶ古き良き沖縄の集落。緑のトンネルに木漏れ日が差し込む幻想的な散策路。
highlights: 約1kmにわたり続く緑豊かなフクギのトンネル散歩・レンタサイクル
三線の音色を聞きながら巡る伝統の水牛車観光
並木道を抜けた備瀬崎海岸でのイノー（浅瀬）観察とシュノーケリング
ja.reservationInfo: 散策自由。水牛車体験は現地受付。
ja.parkingInfo: 備瀬崎入口付近に有料駐車場あり（500円/日）。
ja.openingHours: 終日散策可能（日中の見学08:00〜18:00推奨）。

notes: A peaceful tree-lined lane near Churaumi — walk or rent a bicycle for the full experience.
reservation: None required
parking: Nearby paid parking
notesJa: 古木のフクギ並木が続く静かな小道。レンタサイクルでの散策がおすすめ。

name: Nakijin Castle Ruins

imageMetadata.attribution: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas via Wikimedia Commons

en.name: Nakijin Castle Ruins
en.description: A 14th-century World Heritage fortress of the Hokuzan Kingdom featuring undulating Ryukyu limestone walls snake-like along mountain ridges with sweeping East China Sea ocean views.
highlights: Walk along massive 1.5km curving limestone walls resembling the Great Wall
Take in breathtaking panoramic views of the East China Sea horizon
See early Ryukyu cherry blossoms flowering along the stone steps in January-February
en.reservationInfo: Tickets purchased at ticket office at entrance.
en.parkingInfo: Free visitor parking available on site.

ja.name: 今帰仁城跡
ja.description: 14世紀の北山王の居城跡。龍の背のようにうねる琉球石灰岩の堅牢な城壁と、高台から望むエメラルドグリーンの東シナ海が美しい世界遺産。
highlights: 城壁の曲線美が際立つ全長1.5kmの石垣と平郎門（正門）
主郭跡から見渡す断崖絶壁と東シナ海の水平線
毎年1月下旬〜2月上旬に咲き誇る日本一早いカンヒザクラ（寒緋桜）の名所
ja.reservationInfo: 現地チケット売場にて購入（歴史文化センター共通券）。
ja.parkingInfo: 無料駐車場あり。

highlights: Panoramic views of the East China Sea
notes: One of nine Gusuku sites — visit in late January for Okinawa's earliest cherry blossoms.
reservation: None required
parking: Free parking available
notesJa: 世界遺産の城跡。1月下旬には沖縄で最も早い桜が見られます。

name: Kabira Bay

en.name: Kabira Bay
en.description: Awarded 3 stars by Michelin Green Guide Japan, Kabira Bay features breathtaking multi-hued turquoise waters, black pearl cultivation reefs, and white sand shores.
highlights: Take a glass-bottom boat tour to view giant clams, sea turtles, and corals
Walk up to Kabira Park viewpoint for sweeping bay panoramas
Observe black pearl culture displays at local shore boutiques
en.reservationInfo: Glass-bottom boat tickets available on arrival at beach huts.
en.parkingInfo: Municipal paid parking lot near Kabira Park entrance (¥300).

ja.name: 川平湾
ja.description: ミシュラン・グリーンガイド・ジャポンで最高ランク三ツ星を獲得した石垣島一の景勝地。時間や潮の満ち引きで七色に変化する海と黒真珠の養殖で有名。
highlights: グラスボートで覗く熱帯魚や巨大シャコガイ、サンゴ礁の海中世界
川平公園の展望台から望む小島が浮かぶ絵画のような絶景
ja.reservationInfo: グラスボート乗船券は現地各社で随時購入可能（予約なしでも乗船可）。
ja.parkingInfo: 川平公園有料駐車場あり（300円）。
ja.openingHours: 景観見学は自由。グラスボート運航09:00〜17:00。

notes: Swimming is not allowed in the bay — take a glass-bottom boat to see the coral and pearls.
reservation: Glass-bottom boat tickets at the pier
parking: Free parking available
notesJa: 遊泳禁止の美しい湾。グラスボートでサンゴ礁と真珠養殖を見学できます。

name: Tamatorizaki Observatory

en.name: Tamatorizaki Observatory
en.description: A scenic hill observatory on northeastern Ishigaki Island lined with vibrant red hibiscus flowers, offering panoramic views of Ibaruma Bay and the Hirakubo Peninsula.
highlights: Walk the gentle hibiscus-lined stone path to the hilltop gazebo
Take in 180-degree views of coral reef ocean gradients and green peninsulas
en.reservationInfo: Free open access.
en.parkingInfo: Free public parking lot with clean restroom facilities.
en.openingHours: Open 24/7; best visited during daylight hours.

ja.name: 玉取崎展望台
ja.description: 石垣島北東部に位置する人気絶景ポイント。ハイビスカスが咲き誇る遊歩道を登ると、伊原間湾と平久保半島の美しい海と緑のグラデーションが一望できる。
highlights: 一年中ハイビスカスが彩る石畳の展望遊歩道散策
太平洋と東シナ海を包み込むエメラルドグリーンのパノラマビュー
ja.reservationInfo: 入場自由・無料。
ja.parkingInfo: 無料駐車場完備（公衆トイレ併設）。
ja.openingHours: 終日開放（日中・夕刻の景観がおすすめ）。

highlights: Panoramic view of the northern coastline
notes: Free observation point with views of the Hirakubo Peninsula — best in clear morning light.
reservation: None required
parking: Free parking available
notesJa: 無料の展望台から平久保半島の絶景パノラマ。晴れた午前中がおすすめ。

name: Yonehara Beach & Coral Reef

en.name: Yonehara Beach & Coral Reef
en.description: A wild natural white-sand beach on northern Ishigaki where shallow coral reefs grow right up near the shore, making it a favorite spot for beachgoers and marine life watching.
highlights: Snorkel directly off the white sand beach to view shallow colorful corals and clownfish
Relax under green coastal trees along the tranquil shoreline
en.reservationInfo: Free beach access.
en.parkingInfo: Paid parking lot adjacent to beach showers (¥500/day).
en.openingHours: Open 24/7; swim only during daylight hours.

ja.name: 米原ビーチ
ja.description: 石垣島北部にある白砂の天然ビーチ。浅瀬のすぐ近くまでリアルなサンゴ礁とカラフルな熱帯魚が広がる、シュノーケリングの名所。
highlights: ビーチから数メートル泳ぐだけで会えるクマノミと枝サンゴの群生
木陰が広がる静かな白砂海岸でのんびり海風リラックス
ja.reservationInfo: ビーチ利用無料。
ja.parkingInfo: シャワー施設併設の有料駐車場あり（500円/日）。
ja.openingHours: 終日開放（日中・満潮時のシュノーケリング推奨）。

highlights: Natural coral reef close to shore
notes: Bring your own snorkel gear — the coral starts just metres from the shore at low tide.
reservation: None required
parking: Free parking available
notesJa: 海岸からすぐのサンゴ礁でシュノーケリング。干潮時がねらい目。

name: Yonaha Maehama Beach

en.name: Yonaha Maehama Beach
en.description: Consistently voted Japan's top beach, featuring 7 continuous kilometers of soft white powder sand facing Kurima Island across translucent Miyako Blue water.
highlights: Walk barefoot along 7km of pure white coral powder sand
Try marine jet-skiing, banana boat rides, and stand-up paddleboarding
Watch stunning sunsets painting the sky over Kurima Bridge
en.reservationInfo: Free beach entrance; water sports gear rented on beach.
en.parkingInfo: Free public parking lot with showers and restrooms.
en.openingHours: Open 24/7; lifeguard service during swimming season (April-October).

ja.name: 与那覇前浜ビーチ
ja.description: トリップアドバイザー等で「東洋一の美しさ」と絶賛される宮古島を代表するビーチ。きめ細やかな白砂が7kmにわたって続き、対岸に来間島を望む。
highlights: 裸足で歩いても心地よい7kmの東洋一の白砂パウダービーチ
マリンアクティビティ（ジェットスキー・SUP・バナナボート）体験
来間大橋に沈むオレンジ色の極上サンセット鑑賞
ja.reservationInfo: 入場自由・無料。マリン用品レンタルは現地対応。
ja.parkingInfo: 無料駐車場あり（シャワー・トイレ完備）。
ja.openingHours: 終日開放（監視員配置期間: 4月〜10月）。

highlights: Voted one of Japan's best beaches
notes: One of Japan's top beaches — the shallow water extends far out, ideal for wading and families.
reservation: None required
parking: Free parking available
notesJa: 日本のベストビーチの一つ。遠浅で家族連れにも安心の白砂海岸。

name: Irabu Bridge & Sea Drive

en.name: Irabu Bridge & Sea Drive
en.description: Japan's longest toll-free bridge spanning 3,540 meters over emerald clear ocean, connecting Miyako Island to Irabu Island with exhilarating ocean drive vistas.
highlights: Drive the curving 3,540m ocean highway hovering right over turquoise sea
Stop at observation parking bays on both ends for photos of the bridge arch
Continue driving on Irabu Island to Shimojishima Airport 17END runway beach
en.reservationInfo: Free public bridge access 24/7.
en.parkingInfo: Free viewing plaza parking lots located on both Miyako and Irabu bridgeheads.

ja.name: 伊良部大橋
ja.description: 宮古島と伊良部島を結ぶ全長3,540mの橋。通行無料の橋としては日本最長であり、エメラルドグリーンの海の上を滑るように走る爽快ドライブコース。
highlights: 海の上を駆け抜ける3.5kmの絶景ドライブ体験
橋の全貌を捉える両岸（宮古島側・伊良部島側）の絶景展望スポット
橋を渡って下地島空港17ENDの幻のビーチ散策へステップアップ
ja.reservationInfo: 通行自由・無料。
ja.parkingInfo: 両端の橋詰に無料展望駐車場あり。

highlights: 3,540-metre bridge connecting Miyako and Irabu islands
Free to cross — popular photo stop
notes: Japan's longest toll-free bridge — stop at the roadside station for panoramic photos.
reservation: None required
parking: Free parking at roadside station
notesJa: 日本最長の無料橋。道の駅からのパノラマが絶好の写真スポット。

name: Cape Higashi-Hennazaki

en.name: Cape Higashi-Hennazaki
en.description: A narrow 2km long coral peninsula jutting into the ocean at Miyako Island's easternmost tip, crowned by a white climbable lighthouse with dramatic wave-crashing sea cliff views.
highlights: Climb the 97 steps of the white lighthouse for 360-degree ocean views
Walk the 2km cape peninsula surrounded by wild Okinawan lilies and coral boulders
Watch the sunrise over the Pacific Ocean from the easternmost point
en.reservationInfo: Cape free access; lighthouse entry ¥300 paid at door.
en.parkingInfo: Free public parking lot with cafe and restrooms.

ja.name: 東平安名崎
ja.description: 宮古島の最東端に位置する長さ約2kmの細長いサンゴ礁の岬。白亜の登れる灯台が立ち、太平洋と東シナ海を分かつ荒波と崖のダイナミックな景観が広がる。
highlights: 97段の階段を登る白亜の灯台からの360度大海原パノラマ
津波石が点在する約2kmの岬遊歩道と春に咲くテンニンソウ・テッポウユリ
宮古島一番の初日の出・サンライズ絶景スポット

highlights: Scenic cape at Miyako's easternmost point

highlights: 屋上庭園つばめの杜ひろば
アミュプラザ博多のショッピング
九州新幹線の起点と駅弁・グルメ

name: Fukuoka City Museum

en.name: Fukuoka City Museum
en.description: The Fukuoka City Museum showcases the history and culture of Fukuoka from ancient times to the present. Its most famous exhibit is the solid gold seal 'King of Na of Wa' (a National Treasure) discovered on Shikanoshima Island, dating from the 1st century AD.
highlights: National Treasure gold seal of 'King of Na'
Fukuoka history from ancient to modern

ja.name: 福岡市博物館
ja.description: 福岡市博物館は古代から現代までの福岡の歴史と文化を紹介する総合博物館です。最大の見どころは志賀島で発見された国宝「金印」（漢委奴国王印）で、1世紀の日本と大陸との交流を物語る貴重な文化財です。
highlights: 国宝『金印』（漢委奴国王印）の常設展示
福岡の歴史とアジア交流の展示
企画展と市民文化イベント

en.name: Nagasaki Peace Park & Atomic Bomb Museum
en.description: Nagasaki Peace Park and the adjacent Atomic Bomb Museum commemorate the events of August 9, 1945 and promote a message of peace. The park features the iconic Peace Statue and monuments donated from around the world, while the museum documents the history with powerful exhibits.
highlights: Iconic Peace Statue by Seibo Kitamura

ja.name: 長崎平和公園・原爆資料館
ja.description: 長崎平和公園と隣接する長崎原爆資料館は、1945年8月9日の原爆投下を記憶し平和を発信する場所です。公園には北村西望作の平和祈念像がそびえ、世界各国から寄贈された平和モニュメントが点在。資料館では被爆の実相を伝える展示が行われています。
highlights: 北村西望作の巨大平和祈念像
世界各国からの平和モニュメント
原爆資料館の被爆遺物と歴史展示

name: Glover Garden

en.name: Glover Garden
en.description: Glover Garden is an open-air museum perched on a hillside overlooking Nagasaki Harbor, preserving several Meiji-era Western residences. The centerpiece is the former Glover House, Japan's oldest wooden Western-style building, once home to Scottish merchant Thomas Glover who helped modernize Japan.
highlights: Former Glover House (Japan's oldest Western building)

ja.name: グラバー園
ja.description: グラバー園は長崎港を一望する丘に広がる野外博物館で、明治時代の洋館数棟を移築保存しています。中心となる旧グラバー住宅は日本最古の木造洋風建築で、スコットランド出身の貿易商トーマス・グラバーが日本の近代化に貢献した邸宅です。
highlights: 国指定重要文化財『旧グラバー住宅』
長崎港を見下ろす丘の絶景

name: Dejima

en.name: Dejima
en.description: Dejima was a fan-shaped artificial island built in 1636 that served as Japan's only window to the Western world during the isolation period (1641–1859). Today, meticulously restored warehouses, residences, and exhibits recreate the Dutch trading post where East met West.
highlights: Japan's Edo-era window to the West

ja.name: 出島
ja.description: 出島は1636年に築造された扇形の人工島で、鎖国時代（1641年〜1859年）に西洋に開かれた日本唯一の窓口でした。現在は復元された倉庫や住居、展示施設が当時のオランダ商館の様子を再現し、東西交流の歴史を伝えています。
highlights: 復元されたオランダ商館建造物群
鎖国時代唯一の西洋交易拠点
貿易史を伝える体験型展示

name: Nagasaki Chinatown

en.name: Nagasaki Chinatown
en.description: Nagasaki Shinchi Chinatown is the oldest Chinatown in Japan, dating back to the 17th century when Chinese traders settled near Dejima. Today its narrow streets are lined with vibrant restaurants, street food stalls serving champon and sara-udon, and colorful gates marking each cardinal direction.
highlights: Four colorful gates & Lunar New Year festival

ja.name: 長崎新地中華街
ja.description: 長崎新地中華街は日本最古の中華街で、17世紀に中国人貿易商が出島近くに居を構えたことに始まります。細い路地にはちゃんぽんや皿うどんを供する老舗飲食店が軒を連ね、東西南北を守る四つの色鮮やかな門と春節祭が名物です。
highlights: 日本最古の歴史ある中華街
長崎名物ちゃんぽん・皿うどん
四色の門と春節ランタンフェスティバル

name: Meganebashi Spectacles Bridge

en.name: Meganebashi Spectacles Bridge
en.description: Meganebashi (Spectacles Bridge) is Japan's oldest stone arch bridge, built in 1634 over the Nakashima River. Its name comes from the reflection of its twin arches in the water, which together form the shape of spectacles. It survived the 1945 atomic bombing and remains a beloved symbol of Nagasaki.

ja.name: 眼鏡橋
ja.description: 眼鏡橋は1634年に中島川に架けられた日本最古の石造アーチ橋です。二連アーチが水面に映り眼鏡のように見えることから名付けられました。1945年の原爆投下にも耐えて現存し、長崎のシンボルとして親しまれています。
highlights: 日本最古の石造二連アーチ橋（1634年）
水面に映る眼鏡のような美しいフォルム
1945年原爆にも耐えた長崎の象徴

name: Suizenji Jojuen Garden

en.name: Suizenji Jojuen Garden
en.description: Suizenji Jojuen is a classic Edo-period strolling garden laid out in 1632 by the Hosokawa daimyo clan. The garden features a large central pond with a miniature Mt. Fuji, a recreation of the 53 stations of the Tokaido road, and a traditional teahouse overlooking the serene landscape.

ja.name: 水前寺成趣園
ja.description: 水前寺成趣園は1632年に細川藩によって造営された江戸時代の回遊式庭園です。広大な池を中心に築山の富士山、東海道五十三次を模した景観が広がり、池を見渡す茶屋からは熊本の美しい庭園風景を堪能できます。
highlights: ミニチュア富士山と池泉回遊式庭園
東海道五十三次の縮景
伝統茶屋での抹茶と庭園眺望

name: Kumamoto Prefectural Art Museum

en.name: Kumamoto Prefectural Art Museum
en.description: The Kumamoto Prefectural Art Museum houses a significant collection spanning Japanese and Western art, including works by local Kumamoto artists and pieces related to the Hosokawa samurai clan. Adjacent to Kumamoto Castle, it makes an excellent cultural pairing after exploring the castle grounds.
highlights: Prime location next to Kumamoto Castle

ja.name: 熊本県立美術館
ja.description: 熊本県立美術館は細川家ゆかりの武家美術品から近代の熊本ゆかりの作家まで幅広いコレクションを所蔵しています。熊本城に隣接し、城見学と合わせた文化散策の拠点として最適です。
highlights: 細川家伝来の武家美術コレクション
熊本ゆかりの近代作家作品
熊本城に隣接する好立地

name: Takegawara Onsen

en.name: Takegawara Onsen
en.description: Takegawara Onsen is a historic public bathhouse built in 1879, famous for its striking Meiji-era tiled façade and traditional sand bath (sunaburo) where guests are buried in naturally heated volcanic sand. It's one of Beppu's most iconic onsen landmarks.

ja.name: 竹瓦温泉
ja.description: 竹瓦温泉は1879年に建てられた歴史ある公衆浴場で、唐破風の屋根とタイル張りのファサードが特徴です。名物の砂湯（砂風呂）は火山性の温熱砂に全身を埋めて汗をかく伝統的な入浴法で、別府の象徴的温泉施設の一つです。
highlights: 唐破風のタイル張りファサード

name: Kannawa Onsen Steam District

en.name: Kannawa Onsen Steam District
en.description: The Kannawa district is the spiritual heart of Beppu's onsen culture, where plumes of steam rise from every alleyway. Visitors can cook eggs and vegetables in the natural steam vents (jigoku-mushi), soak in dozens of local bathhouses, and experience the enigmatic 'Steam Bathing' tradition.
highlights: Dozens of local bathhouses & foot onsens
Atmospheric steam vents in every alley

ja.name: 鉄輪温泉湯けむり街
ja.description: 鉄輪温泉は別府の湯けむり文化の中心地で、路地のあちこちから湯けむりが立ちのぼる情緒あふれる温泉街です。地獄蒸し料理を体験できる共同調理場や点在する共同浴場、足湯が散策の楽しみを広げます。
highlights: 地獄蒸し料理体験ができる共同調理場
点在する共同浴場と足湯めぐり
路地の湯けむり景観散策

name: Beppu Tower

en.name: Beppu Tower
en.description: Beppu Tower is a 100-meter observation tower completed in 1957, designed in the style of the Eiffel Tower. Its observation deck offers panoramic views of Beppu Bay, the cityscape, and on clear days the mountains of Shikoku across the Seto Inland Sea.

ja.name: 別府タワー
ja.description: 別府タワーは1957年に完成した高さ100mのエッフェル塔型展望塔です。展望台からは別府湾、市街地、晴れた日には瀬戸内海越しに四国の山並みまで360度の絶景パノラマが楽しめます。
highlights: エッフェル塔型100m展望タワー
別府湾と市街地の360度パノラマ

name: Kinrin Lake

en.name: Kinrin Lake
en.description: Kinrin Lake is a mystical small lake in Yufuin where morning mist rises from the warm spring-fed waters meeting the cold mountain air, creating an ethereal scene. The name means 'Golden Scales' after the shimmering fish scales said to have been seen here at sunset. A walking path encircles the lake.
highlights: Morning mist over the warm spring-fed lake
Scenic walking path around the lake

ja.name: 金鱗湖
ja.description: 金鱗湖は由布院の中心に位置する神秘的な小湖で、湖底から湧く温泉水が冷たい朝の空気と触れて立ちのぼる朝霧が幻想的な風景を作り出します。湖名は日没時に魚の鱗が金色に輝いたという伝説に由来します。湖畔の遊歩道が整備されています。
highlights: 湖面を覆う幻想的な朝霧
湖畔一周の遊歩道散策
紅葉と冬の雪景色のリフレクション

It features boutique shops, cafés, and gift stores, and is famously featured in the Studio Ghibli-inspired atmosphere of Yufuin.

highlights: 絵本のようなイギリス風コテージ群
石畳の小道と小さなショップ巡り
ジブリ風雑貨店とフォトジェニックな街並み

name: Yufuin Onsen District

en.name: Yufuin Onsen District
en.description: Yufuin Onsen is one of Japan's most beloved hot spring towns, nestled at the base of Mount Yufu (Yufudake). Unlike Beppu's dramatic hells, Yufuin charms with its serene countryside atmosphere, upscale ryokan with open-air baths overlooking rice paddies, and a walkable main street lined with cafés and artisan shops.
highlights: Open-air rotenburo with Mount Yufu views
Lake Kinrin morning mist & café street

湯の坪街道のカフェと工芸品店巡り
金鱗湖の朝霧と温泉情緒

name: Dazaifu Tenmangu Shrine

en.name: Dazaifu Tenmangu Shrine
en.description: Dazaifu Tenmangu is one of Japan's most important Shinto shrines, dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane, the deity of learning and scholarship. Built over his grave in 919, the shrine is famous for its 6,000 plum trees that bloom spectacularly in February–March. Students from across Japan come to pray for exam success.
highlights: 6,000 plum trees blooming in early spring
One of Japan's top three Tenmangu shrines
Prayers for academic success & exam luck

ja.name: 太宰府天満宮
ja.description: 太宰府天満宮は学問の神様・菅原道真公を祀る日本有数の神社で、919年に道真公の墓所に創建されました。境内には約6,000本の梅が植えられ、2月〜3月の梅まつりは見事です。受験シーズンには全国から合格祈願の参拝者が訪れます。
highlights: 約6,000本の梅と梅まつり（2〜3月）
学問の神様・菅原道真公の御神徳
日本三天神の一社と合格祈願

name: Kyushu National Museum

en.name: Kyushu National Museum
en.description: The Kyushu National Museum is Japan's fourth national museum, opened in 2005, and the first to focus on the formation of Japanese culture through the lens of Asian exchange. Its innovative exhibits trace cultural connections from prehistoric times through the Silk Road, using cutting-edge display technology.
highlights: Silk Road & Asian trade history displays

ja.name: 九州国立博物館
ja.description: 九州国立博物館は2005年に開館した日本で4番目の国立博物館で、アジアとの文化交流を通じた日本文化の形成をテーマにした初の国立博物館です。先史時代からシルクロードに至る文化交流の歴史を最新の展示技術で紹介しています。
highlights: アジア交流をテーマにした唯一の国立博物館
最新展示技術による文化交流展示
シルクロードとアジア交易史

name: Komyozenji Temple

en.name: Komyozenji Temple
en.description: Komyozenji is a serene Rinzai Zen temple founded in 1273, located just a short walk from Dazaifu Tenmangu. It is renowned for its two exquisite dry landscape gardens (karesansui): one featuring moss and maple representing the word 'light', the other using stones and sand to depict a dragon. Best visited in autumn for spectacular maple colors.
highlights: Peaceful autumn foliage away from crowds

ja.name: 光明禅寺
ja.description: 光明禅寺は1273年創建の臨済宗の禅寺で、太宰府天満宮から徒歩すぐの静かな場所にあります。二つの枯山水庭園があり、苔と紅葉で「光」を表す庭と石と砂で龍を描く庭が特徴です。秋の紅葉の名所として知られ、観光客の喧騒から離れた静寂が魅力です。
highlights: 苔と紅葉の枯山水「光」の庭
石と砂の龍の枯山水庭園

name: Sengan-en Garden

en.name: Sengan-en Garden
en.description: Sengan-en is a magnificent Japanese garden and former villa of the Shimazu clan, the powerful samurai lords of Satsuma domain. Built in 1658, the garden famously 'borrows' Sakurajima volcano as its backdrop (shakkei), creating one of Japan's most dramatic garden vistas. It is part of the UNESCO 'Sites of Japan's Meiji Industrial Revolution'.
highlights: UNESCO World Heritage Meiji industrial site

ja.name: 仙巌園
ja.description: 仙巌園は薩摩藩主・島津家の別邸として1658年に築かれた大名庭園で、桜島を借景とした日本屈指の雄大な庭園景観が特徴です。「明治日本の産業革命遺産」の構成資産として世界遺産にも登録され、武家文化と近代化の歴史が融合した名勝です。
highlights: 桜島を借景にした大名庭園
島津家別邸と薩摩の武家文化
世界遺産『明治日本の産業革命遺産』構成資産

name: Kagoshima City Aquarium
nameJa: いおワールドかごしま水族館
aliases: いおワールドかごしま水族館

en.name: Kagoshima City Aquarium
en.description: Kagoshima City Aquarium (Io World) showcases the rich marine life of the Kuroshio Current that flows past Kagoshima. Its star attraction is the massive Kuroshio Tank featuring whale sharks, the world's largest fish. The aquarium offers dolphin shows and interactive touch pools, all with Sakurajima volcano as the backdrop.
highlights: Whale sharks in the Kuroshio Tank

ja.name: いおワールドかごしま水族館
ja.description: いおワールドかごしま水族館は、鹿児島沖を流れる黒潮の豊かな海洋生物を紹介する水族館です。最大の見どころはジンベエザメが泳ぐ巨大な黒潮大水槽で、桜島を背景にしたイルカショーやふれあいタッチプールも楽しめます。
highlights: ジンベエザメが泳ぐ黒潮大水槽
桜島を背景にしたイルカショー
ふれあいタッチプール体験

name: Nakadake Crater

en.name: Nakadake Crater
en.description: Nakadake Crater is the active volcanic crater at the heart of Mount Aso, Japan's largest active volcano. Visitors can walk to the rim and peer into the churning turquoise crater lake — one of the most accessible active volcanic vents in the world. The crater may close during high volcanic activity; check conditions before visiting.
highlights: Active volcanic crater with turquoise lake
One of the world's most accessible craters

ja.name: 阿蘇中岳火口
ja.description: 阿蘇中岳火口は日本最大の活火山・阿蘇山の中心に位置する活発な火口で、遊歩道で火口縁まで近づきエメラルドグリーンの火口湖を間近に眺められます。火山活動状況により立入規制があるため、訪問前に最新情報を確認してください。
highlights: エメラルドグリーンの火口湖を間近に
世界有数のアクセス可能な活火口
迫力の噴煙と火山ガスの景観

name: Kusasenri Grassland

en.name: Kusasenri Grassland
en.description: Kusasenri is a vast grassland inside the Aso caldera, with a small pond at its center and grazing horses dotting the landscape. The sweeping views of Mount Aso's smoking crater against the green expanse are iconic. Horse riding is available in the meadow, making it a highlight of any Aso visit.
highlights: Vast caldera grassland with grazing horses
Horse riding experience in the meadow

ja.name: 草千里ヶ浜
ja.description: 草千里ヶ浜は阿蘇カルデラ内に広がる広大な草原で、中央の池と放牧された馬の群れが牧歌的な風景を作り出します。阿蘇中岳の噴煙を背景に広がる緑の草原は阿蘇を代表する景観で、乗馬体験も楽しめます。
highlights: 広大なカルデラ草原と放牧馬
中岳火口噴煙を背景にした絶景

name: Daikanbo Viewpoint

en.name: Daikanbo Viewpoint
en.description: Daikanbo is the premier panoramic viewpoint of the Aso caldera at 936 meters elevation, offering a breathtaking 360-degree view of the five peaks of Mount Aso, the vast caldera floor, and on clear days as far as the Kuju mountain range. The sea of clouds phenomenon at sunrise is particularly spectacular.
highlights: Five peaks of Mount Aso in one view

ja.name: 大観峰
ja.description: 大観峰（標高936m）は阿蘇カルデラを一望できる最高の展望スポットで、阿蘇五岳と広大なカルデラの底、晴れた日には九重連山まで360度の大パノラマが広がります。早朝の雲海が特に神秘的で、阿蘇観光のハイライトです。
highlights: 936mの絶景360度カルデラパノラマ
阿蘇五岳の全容を一望
早朝に現れる神秘的な雲海

name: Aso Volcano Museum

en.name: Aso Volcano Museum
en.description: The Aso Volcano Museum sits at the foot of Nakadake Crater and offers a fascinating introduction to the geology and history of Mount Aso. Live camera feeds from inside the crater, 3D volcano models, and exhibits on the 1990s eruption make it an essential stop before or after visiting the crater itself.
highlights: Live crater camera feeds & volcano science

ja.name: 阿蘇火山博物館
ja.description: 阿蘇火山博物館は中岳火口の麓に位置し、阿蘇山の地質と噴火の歴史をわかりやすく紹介する博物館です。火口内部のライブカメラ映像、3D火山模型、1990年代の噴火に関する展示があり、火口見学の前後に立ち寄るのに最適です。
highlights: 火口ライブカメラと火山の科学展示
噴火の歴史と体験型展示

name: Aoshima Island & Devil's Washboard

en.name: Aoshima Island & Devil's Washboard
en.description: Aoshima is a small subtropical island connected to the mainland by a bridge, famous for the 'Devil's Washboard' — a natural formation of parallel basalt rock ridges extending along the shore, created by ancient wave erosion. The island's center houses Aoshima Shrine, a colorful shrine surrounded by lush tropical vegetation.

ja.name: 青島・鬼の洗濯板
ja.description: 青島は橋で本土と結ばれた亜熱帯の小島で、海岸に広がる「鬼の洗濯板」と呼ばれる平行な玄武岩の隆起地形が有名です。島の中心には熱帯植物に囲まれた色鮮やかな青島神社が鎮座し、縁結びのパワースポットとして親しまれています。
highlights: 鬼の洗濯板の奇岩地形
熱帯ジャングルの中の青島神社
橋で渡る亜熱帯の小島散策

en.name: Heiwadai Park & Haniwa Garden
en.description: Heiwadai Park is a hilltop park built to commemorate the 2,600th anniversary of the legendary Emperor Jimmu's enthronement. Its centerpiece is the 37-meter Peace Tower, and the adjacent Haniwa Garden displays hundreds of replica ancient clay figures (haniwa) excavated from local burial mounds, offering a unique glimpse into Japan's Kofun period.
highlights: Hundreds of replica haniwa clay figures

ja.name: 平和台公園・はにわ園
ja.description: 平和台公園は神武天皇即位2600年を記念して造られた丘陵公園で、中心にそびえる高さ37mの平和の塔が象徴的です。隣接するはにわ園には宮崎県内の古墳から出土した埴輪のレプリカ数百体が展示され、古代のロマンを感じさせます。
highlights: 数百体の埴輪レプリカ展示
丘の上からの宮崎市街パノラマ

name: Miyazaki Jingu Shrine

en.name: Miyazaki Jingu Shrine
en.description: Miyazaki Jingu is the most important Shinto shrine in Miyazaki, dedicated to Emperor Jimmu, Japan's legendary first emperor. Set within a vast ancient forest of camphor and oak trees, the shrine's peaceful precincts offer a serene retreat from the city. The Grand Festival in late October features a spectacular horseback archery (yabusame) performance.
highlights: Dedicated to Japan's first Emperor Jimmu

ja.name: 宮崎神宮
ja.description: 宮崎神宮は初代天皇・神武天皇を祀る宮崎県随一の神社で、クスノキやシイの巨木が生い茂る深い森の中に鎮座しています。10月下旬の例大祭では流鏑馬（やぶさめ）が奉納され、境内は静寂で神聖な空気に包まれます。
highlights: 初代天皇・神武天皇を祀る由緒
クスノキの巨木が茂る神域の森
10月例大祭の流鏑馬（やぶさめ）

name: Takachiho Gorge

en.name: Takachiho Gorge
en.description: Takachiho Gorge is a stunning volcanic basalt ravine carved by the Gokase River, with sheer 80-meter cliffs draped in moss and ferns. The iconic Manai Waterfall cascades into the emerald waters below, and visitors can rent rowboats to glide past the falls. The area is steeped in Japanese mythology as the setting of the sun goddess Amaterasu's hiding cave legend.

ja.name: 高千穂峡
ja.description: 高千穂峡は五ヶ瀬川が溶岩を浸食してできた柱状節理の渓谷で、高さ80mの断崖が苔とシダに覆われ、真名井の滝がエメラルドグリーンの水面に落ちる絶景が広がります。貸しボートで滝の真下まで漕ぎ寄せる体験が人気で、天照大神の天岩戸神話の舞台としても知られています。
highlights: 真名井の滝とエメラルド渓谷のボート
高さ80mの苔むす柱状節理の断崖
天照大神・天岩戸神話ゆかりの地

name: Amanoiwato Shrine

en.name: Amanoiwato Shrine
en.description: Amanoiwato Shrine venerates the sacred cave where, according to Japanese mythology, the sun goddess Amaterasu hid herself, plunging the world into darkness until lured out by the other gods. highlights: 天照大神伝説の天岩戸洞窟
日本神話の聖地を訪ねる
山中の静寂な神社と神域の森

en.name: Takachiho Kagura Night Dance
en.description: Takachiho Kagura is an ancient Shinto ritual dance performed nightly at Takachiho Shrine, retelling the myth of Amaterasu hiding in the cave through mesmerizing masked performances. The full 33-dance cycle lasts all night at the annual Yokagura festival, but a condensed 1-hour highlight version is presented year-round to visitors.

ja.name: 高千穂神楽・夜神楽
ja.description: 高千穂神楽は高千穂神社で毎夜奉納される古来の神楽で、天岩戸神話を題材にした面をつけた舞が幻想的です。11月〜2月の夜神楽シーズンには全33番の神楽が一晩かけて舞われますが、通年で1時間のハイライト版を観覧できます。
highlights: 毎夜奉納の神楽・面舞
天照大神伝説を再現する舞台
ユネスコ無形文化遺産の伝統芸能

name: Jomon Sugi Cedar

en.name: Jomon Sugi Cedar
en.description: Jomon Sugi is the oldest and most famous cedar tree on Yakushima, estimated at 2,170–7,200 years old, and considered a symbol of the island's UNESCO World Heritage ancient forest. Reaching it requires an 8–10 hour round-trip hike through the mystical moss-covered forest that inspired Studio Ghibli's Princess Mononoke.

ja.name: 縄文杉
ja.description: 縄文杉は屋久島を代表する最大最古の屋久杉で、推定樹齢2,170〜7,200年とされ、ユネスコ世界遺産の古代森林のシンボルです。スタジオジブリ『もののけ姫』の舞台にもなった苔むす神秘的な森の中を往復8〜10時間かけて訪ねるトレッキングは一生の思い出になります。
highlights: 推定樹齢7,000年の古代屋久杉
往復8〜10時間のUNESCO森林トレッキング
『もののけ姫』の舞台となった苔の森

parking: Trailhead parking at Arakawa Dam
notes: A full-day round-trip hike — start before 5 am and carry all food and water.

name: Shiratani Unsuikyo Ravine

en.name: Shiratani Unsuikyo Ravine
en.description: Shiratani Unsuikyo is Yakushima's most accessible and photogenic moss forest, an ethereal landscape of ancient cedar trees draped in vibrant green moss, babbling streams, and misty ravines. The shorter trails are suitable for casual hikers and offer the iconic mossy forest scenes that inspired Princess Mononoke's dreamlike world.
highlights: Iconic moss forest of Princess Mononoke fame

ja.name: 白谷雲水峡
ja.description: 白谷雲水峡は屋久島で最もアクセスしやすい苔むす森で、鮮やかな緑の苔に覆われた屋久杉の巨木と渓流が織りなす幻想的な風景が広がります。短いコースから太鼓岩までのトレッキングまで、『もののけ姫』の世界そのままの神秘的な光景を楽しめます。
highlights: 『もののけ姫』のモデルとなった苔の森
苔に覆われた屋久杉と巨岩の絶景
1時間〜4時間の多様なトレッキングコース

name: Yakusugi Land

en.name: Yakusugi Land
en.description: Yakusugi Land is a managed nature park on Yakushima featuring well-maintained boardwalk trails through groves of thousand-year-old yakusugi cedars. With trails ranging from 30 minutes to 2.5 hours, it's the most accessible way to experience the island's ancient forest without the full-day Jomon Sugi commitment. Several massive named cedar trees are highlights along the paths.
highlights: Boardwalk trails through ancient cedar groves

ja.name: ヤクスギランド
ja.description: ヤクスギランドは屋久島の自然公園で、よく整備された遊歩道を歩きながら樹齢1,000年を超える屋久杉の巨木群を気軽に観賞できます。30分から2.5時間の多様なコースがあり、縄文杉ほどの体力がなくても屋久島の原生林の魅力を存分に味わえます。
highlights: 樹齢千年超の屋久杉を巡る遊歩道
複数の銘木と原生林の散策

name: Mojiko Retro District

en.name: Mojiko Retro District
en.description: Mojiko Retro District is a beautifully preserved Meiji-era port town along the Kanmon Strait, featuring brick warehouses, the 1914 Mojiko Station (a National Important Cultural Property), and the Mojiko Retro Observation Tower. The waterfront promenade offers views of the Kanmon Bridge and fresh seafood at the local market.

ja.name: 門司港レトロ地区
ja.description: 門司港レトロ地区は関門海峡に面した明治時代の港湾街並みを保存した観光エリアで、1914年建築の門司港駅（重要文化財）や赤レンガ倉庫群、門司港レトロ展望室が立ち並びます。海峡プロムナードからは関門橋を望み、新鮮な海鮮も楽しめます。
highlights: 重要文化財・門司港駅（1914年築）
明治レトロな赤レンガ倉庫とプロムナード
関門海峡の海鮮市場と絶景
ja.openingHours: 営業時間の設定なし（地区エリア）

nameJa: 北九州市漫画ミュージアム
aliases: 北九州市漫画ミュージアム

en.name: Kitakyushu Manga Museum
en.description: The Kitakyushu Manga Museum celebrates the region's rich manga heritage, honoring artists like Leiji Matsumoto (Galaxy Express 999) and other creators born in Kitakyushu. Located in the ARUARU CITY entertainment complex, the museum features original artwork, interactive drawing stations, and a reading library of 50,000+ manga volumes.
highlights: Leiji Matsumoto & local manga artist exhibits

ja.name: 北九州市漫画ミュージアム
ja.description: 北九州市漫画ミュージアムは松本零士（『銀河鉄道999』）をはじめ北九州市ゆかりの漫画家の功績を紹介する文化施設です。ARUARU CITY内にあり、原画展示や体験型の作画コーナー、5万冊以上の漫画が読めるライブラリーを備えています。
highlights: 松本零士と北九州ゆかりの漫画家展示
5万冊以上の漫画ライブラリー
体験型作画コーナーと企画展

name: Kawachi Wisteria Garden

en.name: Kawachi Wisteria Garden
en.description: Kawachi Wisteria Garden is a private hillside garden famous for its spectacular 80m and 110m long tunnels of cascading wisteria blossoms in shades of purple, pink, and white. The garden is open only during wisteria season (late April to mid-May) and autumn foliage season. Reservations are essential during peak bloom.
highlights: Hilltop panoramic views over the garden
en.openingHours: 08:00–18:00 (Only open late Apr-early May and mid-Nov-early Dec)

highlights: 全長110mと80mの藤の花トンネル
4月下旬〜5月中旬の絶景フラワーシーズン
丘の上の藤棚とパノラマ展望

BOSS E-ZO entertainment complex & bay views

name: TOTO Museum

en.name: TOTO Museum
en.description: The TOTO Museum celebrates the centennial of the renowned sanitary ware manufacturer. Located in Kitakyushu, the museum showcases the evolution of plumbing technology, innovative toilet designs, and cultural changes in Japanese bathing and hygiene. About 10 minutes on foot from Kawaraguchi Mihagino Station or 15 minutes by bus from JR Kokura Station.
highlights: Evolution of Japanese toilets and sanitary ware

highlights: 衛生陶器と水まわり製品の歴史展示
目を引く斬新な建築デザイン

name: Karatsu Castle

en.name: Karatsu Castle
en.description: Karatsu Castle, also known as Maizuru Castle, sits on a hill overlooking Karatsu Bay. Originally built in 1608, the current reconstructed keep houses a museum of feudal artifacts and offers panoramic views of the sea and Nijinomatsubara pine grove.
highlights: Panoramic views of Karatsu Bay and Nijinomatsubara
Cherry blossoms in spring around the castle grounds

ja.name: 唐津城
ja.description: 唐津城（舞鶴城）は唐津湾を見下ろす丘の上に立つ城で、1608年に築城されました。現在の復興天守は資料館として武具や調度品を展示し、海と虹の松原のパノラマが楽しめます。
highlights: 唐津湾と虹の松原のパノラマ
武家の甲冑や工芸品の展示

name: Yobuko Morning Market

en.name: Yobuko Morning Market
en.description: One of Japan's three great morning markets, held daily along Yobuko Port since the Edo period. Vendors sell fresh-caught squid, dried fish, local produce, and crafts. Famous for live squid sashimi served at nearby waterfront restaurants.
highlights: Fresh seafood straight from Yobuko Port
Live squid sashimi at waterfront restaurants
Traditional market atmosphere since the Edo period

浜の食堂で味わう活イカ刺身

Views across Karatsu Bay to Karatsu Castle

name: Nanatsugama Sea Caves

en.name: Nanatsugama Sea Caves
en.description: Dramatic basalt sea caves carved into the northern coastline of the Karatsu Peninsula. Seven interconnected caverns, the largest reaching 30 metres high. Viewed from cliff-top walking paths or up close by sightseeing cruise boat departing from Yobuko Port.
highlights: Cliff-top walking paths with dramatic coastal views
Sightseeing cruise into the cave entrances from Yobuko Port
en.openingHours: Cliff paths: open access (daylight hours recommended). Sightseeing cruise: 09:30–16:00 (hourly departures, weather permitting)

highlights: 開聞岳と大海原の大パノラマ
東シナ海に沈む夕日の撮影

description: A scenic cape at the southern tip of the Satsuma Peninsula with sweeping views across to Mount Kaimon and the open ocean. The distinctive white Ryugu Shrine lighthouse marks the point. A popular spot for sunset photography and for viewing the rugged coastline of southern Kyushu.
highlights: Panoramic views of Mount Kaimon and the ocean
Sunset photography over the East China Sea
reservation: None required
parking: Free parking available
notes: Arrive an hour before sunset for the best light — Mount Kaimon silhouetted against the evening sky.
notesJa: 夕日1時間前の到着がベスト — 夕空に映える開聞岳のシルエットが絶景です。

name: Mount Kaimon

en.name: Mount Kaimon
en.description: An iconic 924-metre conical stratovolcano, often called the Mount Fuji of Satsuma. A popular hiking destination with a well-maintained trail to the summit offering 360° views of the Satsuma Peninsula, Lake Ikeda, and the Pacific Ocean. The round-trip hike takes approximately 4–5 hours.
highlights: Conical 'Satsuma Fuji' silhouette visible from miles away
360° summit panorama over the Satsuma Peninsula
Well-maintained hiking trail suitable for fit beginners
en.openingHours: Trail accessible during daylight hours; not recommended after dark or in bad weather

ja.name: 開聞岳
ja.description: 標高924mの美しい円錐形の成層火山で、薩摩富士とも呼ばれています。整備された登山道を登れば山頂から薩摩半島、池田湖、太平洋の360度の眺望が楽しめます。往復約4～5時間の人気ハイキングコースです。
highlights: 遠くからも見える美しい円錐形「薩摩富士」
山頂からの薩摩半島360度パノラマ
健脚者向けに整備された登山道

name: Obi Castle Town

en.name: Obi Castle Town
en.description: A beautifully preserved Edo-period castle town known as the 'Little Kyoto of Kyushu'. Features samurai residences, the restored Obi Castle gate, a historic school, mossy stone walls, and streets lined with Obi cedar. Individual museums, shops and cafés each have separate hours and admission fees.

Historic merchant streets lined with Obi cedar

name: Udo Jingu

en.name: Udo Jingu
en.description: A dramatic Shinto shrine built into a sea cave on the Nichinan coast, dedicated to the father of Emperor Jimmu. The vivid vermilion main hall contrasts with the deep blue ocean. Visitors toss ceramic undama (lucky balls) into a target below for good fortune. A coastal path with steep stairs leads to the cave shrine.
highlights: Shrine built dramatically into a coastal sea cave
Throw ceramic undama (lucky balls) for good fortune
Vermilion architecture against the Pacific Ocean backdrop

ja.name: 鵜戸神宮
ja.description: 日南海岸の海食洞に建てられた劇的な神社で、神武天皇の父を祀ります。鮮やかな朱塗りの本殿と青い海のコントラストが印象的。参拝者は崖下の的に向かって運玉を投げて開運祈願をします。洞窟神社へは急な階段のある海岸遊歩道を進みます。
highlights: 海食洞に建つ劇的な神社建築
開運を願って運玉を投げる体験
太平洋を背景にした朱塗りの社殿

name: Sun Messe Nichinan

en.name: Sun Messe Nichinan
en.description: A coastal theme park famous for its seven authentic replica Easter Island Moai statues, the only officially authorised Moai replicas outside Chile. Features sweeping ocean views, a butterfly garden, a world insect exhibition, and rolling green hills. A managed paid attraction with regular facility hours.

Butterfly garden and world insect exhibition
Rolling green hills with ocean panoramas

en.description: A well-preserved Edo-period merchant district along the Mikuma River, lined with white-walled storehouses, lattice-fronted shops, traditional sake breweries, and historic merchant homes. name: Kangien Academy

en.name: Kangien Academy
en.description: A nationally designated historic site, this Edo-period private academy was founded in 1805 by scholar Hirose Tanso. It educated over 4,000 students from across Japan regardless of social status, a remarkably progressive model. The site includes a small museum displaying the academy's history, teaching materials and original buildings.
highlights: Nationally designated historic private academy site
Founded 1805, educated 4,000+ students regardless of class
Small museum with original teaching materials and buildings

ja.name: 咸宜園
ja.description: 国指定史跡。1805年に儒学者・広瀬淡窓が開いた江戸時代の私塾で、身分に関わらず全国から4,000人以上の門人を受け入れた先進的な学校です。現在は資料館があり、咸宜園の歴史、教育資料、往時の建物を見学できます。
highlights: 国指定史跡の江戸時代の私塾
1805年開塾、身分を問わず4,000人以上が学んだ
当時の教材と建物を展示する資料館

name: Hita Gion Yamahoko Museum

en.name: Hita Gion Yamahoko Museum
en.description: Museum displaying the elaborate floats (yamahoko) used in the Hita Gion Festival, a 300-year-old tradition held each July. The multi-storey floats, up to 10 metres tall, feature intricate carvings, tapestries and mechanical dolls. Some floats may be absent around the festival period when they are in active use.
highlights: Elaborate multi-storey festival floats up to 10 m tall
Intricate mechanical dolls, carvings and tapestries

ja.name: 日田祇園山鉾会館
ja.description: 300年の伝統を持つ日田祇園祭（毎年7月）で使用される豪華な山鉾を展示する博物館。高さ最大10mの多層式の山鉾には精巧な彫刻、綴織、からくり人形が施されています。祭り前後は山鉾が実際の運用で不在となることがあります。
highlights: 高さ最大10mの豪華な多層式山鉾
精巧なからくり人形・彫刻・綴織
300年の伝統を誇る日田祇園祭

name: Onta Pottery Village

en.name: Onta Pottery Village
en.description: A small, secluded pottery village in the mountains of Hita where traditional Onta ware (Onta-yaki) has been produced for over 300 years using water-powered clay crushers. Designated as an Intangible Cultural Property.
highlights: Hear the rhythmic sounds of water-powered clay crushers
Purchase handmade Onta ware directly from local kilns
Explore the preserved traditional mountain village atmosphere
en.openingHours: Open 24 hours (village access); Kiln shops generally open 09:00 - 17:00.

ja.name: 小鹿田焼の里
ja.description: 日田市の山あいに位置する小さな陶芸の里。300年以上にわたり、川の水力を利用した唐臼で土を砕き、伝統的な小鹿田焼（おんたやき）を作り続けています。国の重要無形文化財に指定。
highlights: 川の水力を利用した唐臼の音色
窯元で直接手作りの小鹿田焼を購入
昔ながらの山村の風景を散策

ja.name: 堀川運河
ja.description: 江戸時代（1686年）に飫肥藩によって木材運搬のために開削された歴史ある運河。美しい石垣やアーチ型の堀川橋など、ノスタルジックな風景が広がる日南市油津の景勝地です。
highlights: アーチ型の石橋「堀川橋」を渡る
江戸時代から残る運河の石垣を見学
油津地区のノスタルジックな雰囲気を楽しむ
ja.openingHours: 自由見学（時間制限なし、日中推奨）

description: A historic canal built in the Edo period (1686) by the Obi Domain to transport timber. Today, its stone walls, traditional arched bridge (Horikawa Bridge), and nostalgic atmosphere make it a scenic spot in the Aburatsu area of Nichinan.
highlights: Walk across the historic arched stone Horikawa Bridge
Admire the Edo-period stone walls lining the canal
Enjoy the nostalgic atmosphere of the Aburatsu district
openingHours: Open access (no fixed hours; daylight recommended)
